response.sql: SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS average_large_amount, COUNT(*) AS large_transaction_count FROM trans WHERE amount > 2400 GROUP BY account_id ORDER BY large_transaction_count DESC, account_id ASC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A large transaction has an amount greater than 2400; ties in count are ordered by account ID.

alternatives.interpretation: If the cutoff includes transactions of exactly 2400, use amount >= 2400.
